requested_outcome: Close and publish the four remaining gaps for approved localization, stored map snapshots, unattended catalog freshness and responsive state transitions.
natural_destination: https://vii.spaplus.co plus the authenticated VII administration
authorization_boundary: Implementation, verification and production publication are authorized by Adir in this request. Invented translations, unlicensed map capture and unrelated infrastructure work are forbidden.

lesson_bundle.reason: CMS language publication must be controlled rather than silently leaking source content.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Non-Hebrew CMS publications fail closed while drafts remain editable.

lesson_bundle.reason: A language page must contain audience-native approved text.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Representative English, French and Russian routes are checked for Hebrew leakage and no translation is synthesized.

lesson_bundle.reason: Code and tests are not production completion.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The exact public release, admin diagnostics, map images, catalog timestamps and responsive flows must be observed after publication.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Hebrew still appears in a foreign-language supplier or CMS field.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Reject unapproved localized CMS publications and suppress unapproved supplier values.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Multilingual public audit passes representative routes in en, fr and ru.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Map snapshots still return warming or missing.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Clear stale retry locks when provider configuration changes and add an authorized forced reconciliation with diagnostics.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Representative public snapshot endpoints return 200 image responses and the admin dashboard reports configured provider and ready records.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A delayed cron misses a supplier world.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Add deterministic missed-slot recovery in the ten-minute scheduler while preserving bounded retries and idempotent run IDs.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Unit tests cover exact slots, delayed recovery, retries and safety rejection; production freshness shows all four worlds.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A gallery, map or filter breaks after rotation or breakpoint changes.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Run a stateful Playwright matrix through mobile, landscape, tablet, desktop and back to mobile across affected templates.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: No state disappears, overflows, escapes the viewport or leaves a stale lock after close.

midpoint_gate.trigger: After root-cause patches and before freezing the release candidate
checks: local/public baseline transition runner produces deterministic evidence

attack_questions: Can an untranslated CMS draft become public?
Can a newly configured map provider remain blocked by yesterday's retry?
Can a delayed cron miss a world forever?
Can an open overlay survive a mobile-desktop-mobile transition with stale body locks?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Public release identity plus direct public and authenticated admin observations
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Multilingual, map, catalog and responsive reports from the frozen release

effectiveness.baseline: v645 has four documented uncertified gaps
effectiveness.target: All four requirements have public evidence with no unresolved blocker.
